facility.purpose: Acquisition and fit-out of a dedicated Grade-A refrigerated warehouse unit (8,500 sq m) in Bhiwandi Logistics Park, Maharashtra, to expand cold storage capacity for perishable agri-produce
facility.security: First mortgage on warehouse unit; hypothecation of refrigeration plant and equipment; personal guarantee of promoter directors

rm_notes: Sunrise is a 7-year relationship. Revenue has compounded at 22% over 3 years driven by contracts with two national supermarket chains. The Bhiwandi unit is pre-leased at 55% capacity to FreshKart Retail, reducing revenue risk significantly. No prior defaults or restructures.
